metadata.description: Fulcra plugins for Claude Code: agent skills for working with your Fulcra data, plus an optional MCP connector.

plugins.name: fulcra-skills
plugins.description: Skills that let your AI agent work with Fulcra: onboarding, custom data tracking, dashboards, memory backup, agent teams, preferences, and data ingest. Uses the Fulcra CLI (uvx fulcra-api).

plugins.name: fulcra-mcp
plugins.description: Connects Claude to the hosted Fulcra Context MCP server for direct data access. Recommended for restricted environments where the Fulcra CLI cannot run.
